samples.identification: Go overwrite infector carrying embedded GravityRAT GX / LSASS
samples.marker_line: Go infector + GravityRAT: program overwrites; adds inventory theft rules
evidence: Recovered the Go 1.2-era pclntab at file offset 0x3f5920 (4842 functions). Rizin call targets were resolved from this table; code was inspected without executing the image.

main.main at VA 0x62d190 reads its own image, obtains generation marks, sends generation/self-hash/path telemetry via HTTP GET, plants randomized copies, and walks C:\Program Files\ using main.visit at 0x62c450.

main.visit reads a matched file, constructs a mutated self image, overwrites the visited path via ioutil.WriteFile, then writes a generation-marked variant. This is file replacement, not an installer updating its own component.

main.get_self_mutated_bytes at 0x62cf80 decodes the embedded base64 PE, appends it and random padding to self bytes. No inspected Go path launches that embedded CLR image; its RAT capabilities are reported for the embedded module.

main.plant_start_up at 0x62cba0 writes mutated copies under C:\Windows\System32\. main.add_startup at 0x62cae0 opens HKLM Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run and writes the copied path as a string value. Runtime permission success was not observed.

Decoded the PE at base64 file offset 0x2ca606: assembly LSASS, version 1.09.1201.10. CLR Program.Main -> Services.Start -> DomainController.Start -> Manager.TaskJobs. The received task switch routes Args to CmdManager.Start; hidden cmd.exe /c redirects output to a report and UploadManager sends it using WebClient.UploadFileTaskAsync.

PortManager.Start executes netstat -a and uploads its report. ServicesManager.DoViaController calls ServiceController.GetServices, formats ServiceName, DisplayName, ServiceType and Status, writes the report, and its Start uploads it. These distinct source-to-send paths justify the two new hostile detections.

ProcessManager enumerates running processes and uploads a formatted report. FileHelper.GetFiles recursively enumerates directories and filters nonempty files through ext_array; ScanManager collects drive documents, while UsbManager watches Win32_LogicalDisk arrival, stages filtered files and periodically uploads them.

Environment probes include BIOS, ComputerSystem, CPU/core count and MSAcpi_ThermalZoneTemperature; identifiers and the reported VM status are submitted to GX-Server.php. Existing identity, process, file, shell, VM and GravityRAT signatures remain supported.
Family-specific GX endpoint/protocol and USB task strings agree with the cited Talos GravityRAT analysis. Sample filename family labels and sandbox score were not used as behavioral proof.

samples.identification: Trojanized Toggle Sprint Display Fabric mod, labeled entropyclient-3.1.4
samples.marker_line: Fabric token stealer: session POST and memory loader; fix JVM traits
evidence: The manifest claims Toggle Sprint Display 2.0.2 by Aeltumn; the original HUD/config classes remain, but main initialization is wired to fgaymqkubs.kezsnntc.wgua5y.O.

JADX and bytecode facts: O.onInitialize calls Minecraft.getInstance().getUser(), reads name/profile UUID/getAccessToken, and adds them to Gson JSON. O.o0e sends that JSON to /api/receive/sess through i.iI4, which writes a POST request plus JSON body onto SSLSocket.

O.lld obtains /api/static/loading; the response becomes a JarInputStream, is split into class/resource maps, and a custom ClassLoader defines classes from those bytes. It instantiates com.example.Main and reflectively invokes initialize(String) with the serialized session. Exceptions are swallowed and the work is threaded.

Decoded all arithmetic-masked string getters by reproducing 32-bit state updates and XOR masks in Python, without executing Java classes. The RPC template is eth_call; contract bytes reconstruct 0x9044f5762e43b23ba91d124b51a045f1b51da652 and selector 0x1f1bd692. The resolver iterates 20 public RPC endpoints and parses an ABI dynamic string to obtain the host.

The HTTP helper optionally resolves names through DNS-over-HTTPS using 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8, preserves SNI, and uses default TLS trust managers. It does not install a permissive trust manager. Existing PBKDF2 algorithm-name finding in a decoy class does not prove key derivation.

Three hostile traits already cover credential handoff, obfuscated remote JAR activation and raw-TLS session exfiltration. All are retained. Eight neutral API/name observations are relocated without narrowing their matchers or losing these behaviors.

Benign user-profile and resource-loader controls establish that getAccessToken/getProfileId method names and ClassLoader references do not identify Minecraft, credential theft or source manipulation by themselves. Their observations remain notable in neutral homes.

samples.marker_line: dotnet Arcade: upstream-identical build tests; retain real DLL mismatch
evidence: Forager fetched the exact versioned GitHub PURL into scratch with .forage.json provenance. SHA256 equals the original archive byte for byte.

All suspicious findings are the same real PE-header DLL/executable-suffix mismatch: standalone Simple.exe and three Simple1/Simple2 ZIP members have identical SHA256 dcd5a867480fee469a37ff890446f4a34b7770edde4dd939a0313f1d3b3aaf99.

dnfile/dncil confirm assembly EmptyPKT 1.0, PE characteristics 0x2022, no CLR entry point, and only Class1::.ctor: ldarg.0; call System.Object::.ctor; nop; ret. The native thunk is mscoree._CorDllMain. No executable payload is present in these fixtures.
SignToolTests.FilesAreUniqueByName explicitly uses these archives to test content-plus-name deduplication and signing configuration. The tests do not execute the empty assemblies.

The high-scoring InstallDotNetCore target chmods the configured installer and invokes the SDK task with Versions.props/global.json configuration. XHarness projects download named .NET test apps, run tests in Apple simulators/devices and uninstall them. These operations agree with the source archive purpose; accurate download, chmod, process and cleanup findings remain.

The backport workflow declares dotnet/arcade@main. The dependency was scanned separately before and after; both snapshots have the same content hash and H0/S1 unique with four leaf mismatch occurrences. No dependent-only exception or dependency suppression was added.

Both source archive and isolated dependency remain classifier prob=1.0. The retained mismatch is accurate; the hostile classifier label is unsupported by the inspected build/test paths and authentic provenance.

severity_changes.reason: Class-loader API reference is analyst-relevant, not near-universal behavior.

ancestor_consumers.credential_access: Only ide-mcp.yaml broad credential selectors; their JavaScript scope cannot match these class-only atoms. Their intended credential subject does not include generic field-name constants.
ancestor_consumers.data_source_and_game: No broad ancestor selectors found for the moved data/source and game atoms. Exact consumers were updated, including the retained system-classloader composite.
ancestor_consumers.destination: No existing broad selectors of the destination import/name/runtime leaves were found that would add unrelated evidence.

controls.validation: Run make validate as final action after markers.
controls.existing_cglib_fixture: Updated stale source/dynamic/reflect expectation to require both metadata/import/jvm and process/interpreter/runtime/jvm, preserving class-loader reference, class-loading, generation coverage and the existing benign score cap.

limits: No specimen code executed; runtime success, machine deployment, authorization and privilege context are unavailable. Static effects suffice for the two malicious verdicts.
The Go executable uses testing-style HTTP telemetry; this does not establish authorization for the observed overwrite and Run-key behavior. No unobserved launcher for its embedded RAT is asserted.

Direct eth_call verification was attempted against two decoded public RPC providers and both returned HTTP 403. A historical same-contract endpoint systemnotifier.st yielded a separate JAR e38de34d29cfce09d3868e6d0cf4bcb1c0c23e21f02bc28c8291506ca4b607e2. It was scanned/decompiled: browser/Discord/file collection, uploads, Python staging and app-file replacement are present. Current on-chain resolution was not verified, so its additional behaviors are not attributed to the original mod bytes.

Initial command spelling followed additional cached GitHub references for Arcade. Comparable baseline and final scans were repeated with --follow=none; they analyze the identical 1971 archive units. The fetched Arcade main dependency is tested separately.
Atomscan warns that the v18 feature specification predates expected v21. Classifier disagreement for Arcade persists after accurate rules are preserved.
